objections.quote: she won't wear something that big
She already has a chain. We wanted a necklace.

coaching_tip: When the family asks for a slim 25-30 g necklace, show necklaces in that weight first, and if none are on hand, offer to source one and take their number instead of switching to a chain or bangles.
